concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: interactive_vs_programmatic_setting
concepts.gloss: S is an interactive setting where the assistant is interacting with a human in real time, as opposed to a programmatic setting where output is consumed programmatically

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries user-level instruction authority, as established in the #avoid_overstepping section

concepts.name: transformation_task
concepts.gloss: T is a task asking the assistant to transform text: translate between languages, add annotations, change formatting, or similar

concepts.name: changes_warranted
concepts.gloss: the assistant judges that changes to the text are warranted beyond what was explicitly asked
concepts.inference: the clause says the assistant 'may want to alert' that changes are warranted; this presupposes a judgment that such changes are warranted

concepts.name: interactive_setting

ontology.gloss: A is an assistant in an interactive setting for a transformation task where changes to the text are warranted
